lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na3Si2 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell of Na12Si8 containing 20 atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Na centers with 11–12 geometric neighbors, while Si centers adopt 9- and 12-neighbor environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face contacts between Na and Si polyhedra and among Na polyhedra.
